answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the shale check immediately, the orchard audit keeps the resolved set and the jade replay exposes exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Copying the same citations across 143 aliases thus pays the reading cost 143 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
